retainedReferenceControl.title: Grand Mosque of Paris
retainedReferenceControl.reason: No unique physical footprint or centerline with exact Wikidata identity has been resolved.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Four actually inspected2011/2015/2016 minaret/garden,patio,portal and street pictures plus standard viewer PMTiles/DEM. No exact-QID building match;named POI/location/picture identity accepted as approximation. No bespoke surveys or redistributed pictures.

pictures.author: Madorielaoshi
pictures.observed: Viewed minaret from garden:cream square shaft with large recessed diamond-pattern fields,lower blind arches,green mosaic upper band,crenellated terrace,smaller square lantern/pyramidal cap and stacked orb finial. White garden walls/green eaves,planted beds and elongated basin. Fine carving/planting abstracted.

pictures.author: Guilhem Vellut
pictures.observed: Viewed white horseshoe patio arcades on paired slender columns,green tiled eaves/dark timber upper frieze,blue-green tiled lower back walls and broad pale paving/central bowl. Temporary transparent truss canopy seen2016 is omitted from this fixed exterior reconstruction;current cover state unverified.

pictures.author: Guilhem Vellut
pictures.observed: Viewed western principal entrance adjacent to minaret:cream shoulders and horseshoe recessed opening,mosaic upper strip,stepped crenellated top,sparse paired side windows,steps and gold crescent/outlined star. Fine inscriptions/floral carving and exact threshold/ramp geometry omitted.

pictures.author: Pergl Pergl
pictures.observed: Viewed long pale street elevation with rough stone base,green tile eaves,three tall dark arched fields,smaller side windows and timber-fronted porch rhythm. Green pyramidal roof/orb finial appears behind wall. Wall/roof profiles and selected exterior windows approximated;fine grilles/lanterns omitted.
